autoRollback.title: Auto-rollback on crashloop
autoRollback.enabledLabel: Redeploy the last working image automatically
autoRollback.description: When a crashloop alert fires for this app, redeploy the most recent successful image older than the one that is crashlooping. This happens at most once per episode. If there is no older image, the alert is all you get.

predeploySnapshot.title: Pre-deploy database snapshot
predeploySnapshot.unavailable: Pre-deploy snapshots are not available on this control plane.

modeHints.off: No snapshot is taken before a deploy.
modeHints.on: Snapshot linked databases first. A failed snapshot is recorded and the deploy still goes ahead.
modeHints.require: Snapshot linked databases first. A failed snapshot blocks the deploy.

toast.errorTitle: Could not save the snapshot setting.

rollbackWithData.title: Roll back with data
rollbackWithData.description: Redeploys the release before this deploy and restores the databases from the snapshot taken just before it.
rollbackWithData.warning: Each linked database is restored into a new database and the app's links are swapped to the copies. The original databases are not changed, but writes made since this deploy stay behind in them.
rollbackWithData.reasonNoSnapshot: No usable snapshot was taken before this deploy.
rollbackWithData.reasonProtected: This app is in a protected environment. Use the plain rollback and restore the data by hand.
rollbackWithData.reasonLoadFailed: Could not load the snapshots for this app.
rollbackWithData.menuHint: Undo this deploy and restore its pre-deploy snapshot

autoRollbackSloBurn.title: Auto-rollback on SLO burn
autoRollbackSloBurn.defaultDescription: Choose how this app reacts when an SLO burn-rate alert fires.

auto.label: Auto rollback
auto.description: Roll back right away to the most recent successful image older than the one burning the error budget.

dry_run.label: Dry run
dry_run.description: Log what would have been rolled back, without deploying.

pause_for_human.label: Pause for human
pause_for_human.description: Open a pending deploy approval for the rollback instead of deploying directly. A teammate approves or rejects it.

toast.modeSet: Auto-rollback on SLO burn set to: {{mode}}.
toast.errorTitle: Could not update auto-rollback on SLO burn.

badgeSettings.title: Deploy status badge
badgeSettings.description: Serves a small public SVG showing this app's latest deploy status and when it happened. No authentication is required. Leave this off if the deploy status should not be public.

toast.errorTitle: Could not update the deploy status badge.

source.git_push: a git push to the server
source.poll: a poll, because a webhook was missed
source.upload: a directory uploaded from the CLI

imageAutoUpdate.title: Update when the image changes
imageAutoUpdate.description: Checks this app's image tag against its registry on a schedule and redeploys when the tag points at a new digest. Apps built from source, stopped apps and apps in a deploy freeze are skipped. A registry push to a protected environment files a deploy approval instead.
imageAutoUpdate.enabledLabel: Redeploy automatically when the tag moves

status.updateAvailable: A newer image is available for this tag.
status.archMismatch: This image is built for {{image}} but the node runs {{node}}. It may fail to start.

window.label: Only update during a window
window.invalid: Enter a cron schedule and a window length of at least 1 minute.
window.waiting: A newer image is waiting for the next update window.

imageAutoUpdate.webhookHelp: Registry push webhook: update on push instead of waiting for the next interval.
imageAutoUpdate.webhookSet: A registry push webhook is set. Creating a new one replaces it.
imageAutoUpdate.webhookShownOnce: Copy this now. It is not shown again. Paste it as a webhook (POST) in your registry. The URL itself is the secret.

providerHint.dockerhub: Docker Hub: repository Webhooks, add the URL. Docker Hub sends no digest, so the tag is resolved first.
providerHint.ghcr: GitHub (ghcr.io): Settings, Webhooks, content type application/json, event Packages, and the secret above. Unsigned deliveries are refused.
providerHint.protected: A push deploys the pushed digest for this app's own image and tag. In a protected environment it files an approval instead.

canary.title: Canary release
canary.description: Run a new image next to the current release and send it a share of requests. Promote it when it looks healthy, or abort and all traffic stays on the current release. A canary that is not ready gets no traffic. Needs a single-replica image app.
canary.next: {{reason}} ({{elapsed}}s of {{interval}}s). It rolls back automatically if errors or latency rise against the stable release.
canary.waitingForTraffic: Waiting for the canary to receive traffic before this stage is judged.

outcome.rolled_back: Last canary was rolled back automatically

templateUpgrade.confirmBody: Risk: {{risk}}. A fresh volume backup is required. The release is watched and rolled back automatically if it crash loops or fails.

run.succeeded: Upgrade finished and the app is healthy
run.rolled_back: Upgrade failed and was rolled back
run.rollback_failed: Upgrade failed and the rollback was refused

envCompare.title: Compare env with another app
envCompare.summary: {{count}} keys identical. Secret values are never read. Secrets match by key only.

appSleep.title: Sleep when idle
appSleep.description: Stop this app after a while with no requests, so it uses no memory or CPU. The next request to its domain starts it and shows a short waking-up page that retries on its own. The first visitor waits for the cold start.
appSleep.holdHelp: A request that arrives while the app is asleep waits for it to start and is then replayed, instead of showing a waking-up page. Use this for API callers.
appSleep.fleetEmpty: No app sleeps when idle yet. Turn it on from an app's Deploys tab to free its memory while nobody visits.
appSleep.sleepNowHelp: Stop the app now instead of waiting for the idle time. The next request starts it.
appSleep.fleetAllAwake: Every app with sleep on is awake right now.
appSleep.fleetNoLimits: These apps have no memory limit, so the memory they free can't be estimated. Set a limit on each app to see it here.

explain.generic: When nobody uses this app for a while, it is stopped to free memory and CPU. The next visitor starts it again and waits for a cold start.

wakeTiming.none: No wakes measured yet, so there is no estimate of how long a wake takes.

appSleep.allClear: Nothing blocks sleep for this app.
appSleep.turnOnHint: Sleeps after {{minutes}} minutes without use. You can change this afterwards.

portWake.title: Wake on traffic to published ports
portWake.help: A connection to port {{ports}} wakes the app, so it can sleep even with a pinned host port.
portWake.aria: Wake on traffic to published ports

ignore.title: Ignored paths
ignore.help: Requests to these paths never keep the app awake: health checks and uptime monitors.

releaseNotes.title: Commits and release notes
releaseNotes.digestSame: Same image digest on both sides.
releaseNotes.noCommits: No commits between these two deploys.
releaseNotes.copyFailed: Could not copy to the clipboard.
releaseNotes.needsDeploy: Pick two deploys that recorded a git commit to generate release notes.

githubActions.title: GitHub Actions reporting
githubActions.description: When the Levelrail deploy action runs in your workflow, it records a GitHub deployment and a check run on the commit, so the result shows on the pull request. A failed report never fails the deploy.
githubActions.snippetHint: Use glincker/levelrail/integrations/github-action in your workflow, or run levelrail-cli apps github-actions get {{app}}.

toast.errorTitle: Could not save GitHub Actions reporting.

ciDeploy.title: Deploy from CI
ciDeploy.description: Trust a pipeline and ref, then paste the setup into your CI. The job swaps its identity (GitHub, GitLab or CircleCI) for a 15 minute token that can only deploy this app, so no long-lived secret is stored. A commit with [skip ci] does not deploy.
ciDeploy.noTrusts: No pipeline is trusted to deploy this app yet. Add one below.
ciDeploy.needsAddress: CI tokens are issued for the dashboard address, and none is set yet.

toast.addressError: Could not save the dashboard address.
toast.copyFailed: Could not copy to the clipboard.

ciDeploy.issuerNote: Leave the issuer empty for gitlab.com. Only a root user can trust a self-managed GitLab issuer, because whoever runs it can mint tokens.
ciDeploy.unprotectedWarning: This trust accepts pipelines on unprotected branches and tags. Any developer who can push a matching ref can deploy.
ciDeploy.snippetNote: Set LEVELRAIL_API_URL to the dashboard address. It is public, not a secret.

buildHooks.title: Build hooks
buildHooks.description: A build hook is a secret URL. POST to it (from a headless CMS or a cron job) to build and deploy this app's git source. An optional JSON body with title and body reaches the build as the TRIGGER_TITLE and TRIGGER_BODY build args.
buildHooks.empty: No build hooks yet. Create one to trigger builds from outside.
buildHooks.shownOnce: URL for {{name}}. Copy it now. It is not shown again.

toast.copyFailed: Could not copy to the clipboard.

banner.title: Deployments
banner.description: Every release across your apps, live while it builds, with one-click rollback. Deploy an app and it appears here.
banner.compactDescription: Releases across every app, with rollback.

rolloutPolicy.title: Rolling update budget
rolloutPolicy.infoBody: Values are a count or a percentage, such as 1 or 25%. Leave a field empty to use the server default.
rolloutPolicy.hint: How many replicas may be added or unavailable while a new release rolls out. Same block as rollout in app.yaml.
rolloutPolicy.saveFailed: Could not update the rollout policy.

error.format: Use a whole number or a percent, such as 1 or 25%.
error.percent: A percent must be between 0% and 100%.
error.bothZero: Max surge and max unavailable can't both be 0, or the rollout could never progress.

page.title: Deployments
page.noMatchHint: Try removing a filter or widening your search.
page.emptyDescription: Deploys appear here as soon as an app is built and released.
page.drawerNotFound: Deployment not found. It may have been pruned by retention.

summary.unavailableTip: The summary could not be loaded. The list below still works.
summary.failureRateTip: Failed deploys as a share of deploys that finished in the last 24 hours.
summary.medianDurationTip: Median time of deploys that finished in the last 24 hours.

supersededPopover.title: Auto-cancel superseded deploys
supersededPopover.description: A newer queued deploy of a branch replaces older queued ones. Builds already running are never canceled. Set per app.

deployList.enterToUse: Press Enter to use this value.

ciTemplates.title: Pipeline file for your CI
ciTemplates.description: Pick your CI to get a ready pipeline file for this app. GitHub, GitLab and CircleCI use a short-lived identity token, so nothing long-lived is stored. Jenkins and Buildkite use a deployer token that can only read and deploy.
ciTemplates.saveAs: Save this as {{target}} in your repository.
ciTemplates.needsDomain: No dashboard URL is set yet. Set one in Settings so your CI can reach this control plane.
ciTemplates.oidcNote: Add a trusted pipeline in Deploy from CI first, then no token is stored in your CI.

token.label: Deployer token
token.shownOnce: Copy this now. It is not shown again.
token.helpScoped: This file reads a stored token. The token is limited to this app's project and can read and deploy every app in that project, nothing outside it. It can only: {{abilities}}. Store it as a secret in your CI.
token.helpInstallWide: This file reads a stored token. This app is in no project, so the token can deploy any app on this server and can only: {{abilities}}. Prefer an OIDC pipeline, or move the app into a project first.
token.helpUnavailable: This file reads a stored token. This server cannot limit a token to the app's project, so the token can deploy any app on this server and can only: {{abilities}}. Prefer an OIDC pipeline.

ciTemplates.apiUrl: Set LEVELRAIL_API_URL to {{url}} in your CI.
